skills.name: Blessed Hammers
skills.desc: Upper-body cast; three or more hammers of light spiral round him for about 3 s, hitting whatever they touch. Light.

skills.name: Hammer Throw
skills.desc: A hammer of light made in the fist and thrown end over end, 18 damage; it comes back to the hand (the catch is Sword_Block). Light.

skills.name: Smite
skills.desc: Shield jab with a board, overhead blow without: 9 bash, 1.1 s stun, a shove and a pillar of light on each foe hit. Light.

skills.name: Consecration
skills.desc: Mace into the ground: hallowed ground r2.8 for 7 s burns foes (the dead twice over) and heals allies. Light.

skills.name: Holy Light
skills.desc: Upper-body cast; heals the most hurt ally or the player within 14 m for 30–35% of their health. Light.

skills.name: Zeal
skills.desc: Five fast blows, 6 damage each, the last 10 and a shove; crescents of light. Light.

skills.name: Blessed Shield
skills.desc: The board thrown (by hand, no clip): bounces between foes for 15 bash and a 0.5 s stun, then comes back to be caught. Light.

skills.name: Holy Nova
skills.desc: Arms up: a blast r4 for 12 bash, a shove and 0.8 s stun; heals allies 8%. Light.

skills.name: Crusader's Charge
skills.desc: Shield_Dash with a board, Sword_Dash without: runs through the line at 15 m/s, 14 bash, 0.6 s stun, braced at the end. Light.

skills.name: Fist of the Heavens
skills.desc: Weapon to the sky, pose held: lightning on the foe and others, 14 burn, 0.5 s stun. Light.

skills.name: Divine Shield
skills.desc: A ward and a 12% heal on the most hurt ally, a shell for 6 s. Light.

skills.name: Heaven's Fury
skills.desc: Pose held about 2 s: four or more pillars of light on and round foes, 11 burn each. Light.

skills.name: Judgment Beam
skills.desc: Arm pointed, pose held: an 11 m beam that tracks for 1.25 s, burning and pushing. Light.

skills.name: Solar Hammer
skills.desc: A giant hammer falls on the foe: 34 bash r2.6, 1.5 s stun, lines of fire and hallowed ground. Light.

skills.name: Storm of Hammers
skills.desc: Pose held about 2.4 s: a dozen or more hammers rain round the foe, 9 bash each. Light.

skills.name: Charge
skills.desc: Lance couched, runs at 15 m/s up to 8.5 m through foes, untouchable on the way, braced at the end. Storm.

skills.name: Shield Wall
skills.desc: Guard for 4 s behind boards of light; everything within 8 m comes for him. Storm, frost.

skills.name: Shield Bash
skills.desc: 8 bash r1.8, 1.1 s stun, a shove. Storm.

skills.name: Lance Barrage
skills.desc: Four thrusts down a line, 7 each, the last 11 and a knock-back. Storm.

skills.name: Tower Shields
skills.desc: Boards of light orbit him for 10 s, 4 bash each, and draw foes to him. Storm, frost.

skills.name: Sweeping Cleave
skills.desc: A flat arc r3.3, 13 bash, shove. Storm.

skills.name: Shield Throw
skills.desc: The board thrown upright through the whole line and back, 13 bash, 0.5 s stun. Storm.

skills.name: Sunspear
skills.desc: A spear of light thrown, piercing, 18, 0.8 s stun. Light.

skills.name: Bulwark Nova
skills.desc: The board slammed down: blast r4.2, 12 bash, 1.2 s stun, shove, draws foes. Storm, frost.

skills.name: Lance of Light
skills.desc: A beam of lance-light down an 11 m line, 22, knock-back. Storm, light.

skills.name: Valiant Leap
skills.desc: Leaps board-first onto the foe: 16 bash r3, 0.9 s stun, shove. Storm.

skills.name: Phalanx Rush
skills.desc: Three dashes in a row at 18 m/s through the nearest foes, 12 each, 0.5 s stun. Storm.

skills.name: Spear Wall
skills.desc: A row of spears bursts from the ground, 14 r3, 1 s stun, lifts foes. Storm.

skills.name: Charge of the Order
skills.desc: Five ghostly lancers charge in a wedge, 20 each, 1 s stun; he guards 6 s. Storm, frost.

skills.name: Rain Of Arrows
skills.desc: Bow lofted, pose held: about 55 arrows rain over r3.5 for 1.3 s. Her string's element.

skills.name: Volley
skills.desc: Five arrows split over nearby foes, 9 each.

skills.name: Strafe
skills.desc: No clip: sprints sideways for about a second, loosing up to 8 arrows (6 each).

skills.name: Disengage
skills.desc: Springs 6.5 m back, three arrows (7 each) in the air.

skills.name: Piercing Arrow
skills.desc: A fast arrow through three or more foes, 13.

skills.name: Split Shot
skills.desc: The arrow splits in flight into three or more seeking arrows, 8 each.

skills.name: Guided Arrow
skills.desc: A seeking arrow lofted wide, 16. Spirit.

skills.name: Explosive Arrow
skills.desc: Bursts r2.4 for 15 burn, shove, fire on the ground 3 s. Fire.

skills.name: Frost Arrow
skills.desc: An ice burst r2.5, 9, 1.5 s stun, slowed 3.5 s. Frost.

skills.name: Sniper Shot
skills.desc: A long draw: 32 (half again past 12 m), 0.6 s stun, shove.

skills.name: Constellation Shot
skills.desc: The arrow bounces across three or more foes, 10 each. Spirit.

skills.name: Arrow Storm
skills.desc: A bigger rain: r4.2, 120 or more arrows over 2.6 s.

skills.name: Black Hole Arrow
skills.desc: A vortex pulls foes in for 3 s, then bursts r4 for 24 bash, 0.8 s stun. Void.

skills.name: Kite
skills.desc: No clip: backs off to a clearer spot (walking and running).

skills.name: Vanish
skills.desc: Smoke, hidden 0.7 s, reappears behind the foe and stabs for 26 (backstab), bleeding. Void, drain.

skills.name: Flurry
skills.desc: Six bleeding cuts, 4.5 each, the last 8. Drain, arcane.

skills.name: Backflip
skills.desc: A bleeding cut if close, then a back somersault 5.5 m throwing three knives.

skills.name: Flip Strike
skills.desc: Flips forward onto the foe: 15 (backstab), bleeding, 0.4 s stun.

skills.name: Fan of Knives
skills.desc: A half turn throwing ten or more knives in a fan, 5 each, bleeding.

skills.name: Rupture
skills.desc: A stab, then a slash for 13 that bleeds hard. Drain.

skills.name: Whirling Blades
skills.desc: A low cartwheel through foes, cutting 3–4 times, bleeding.

skills.name: Smoke Bomb
skills.desc: A lobbed flask: smoke r3.6 for 4.5 s, 1.4 s stun and slowed. Void.

skills.name: Shadow Dance
skills.desc: Blinks behind three or more foes in turn, about 20 each, bleeding, then home. Void.

skills.name: Death from Above
skills.desc: A high double flip down onto the foe: 30 (backstab), 1 s stun, bleeding.

skills.name: Eviscerate
skills.desc: A finisher, 26 (more on a bleeding foe), backstab.

skills.name: Backstab
skills.desc: No clip: any blow within about 60° of a foe's back does 1.8 times the damage.

skills.name: Shadow Step
skills.desc: Vanishes and blinks behind the foe, cuts for 16 (backstab). Void, arcane.

skills.name: Leaping Kick
skills.desc: A flying flip kick: about 14 bash, shove, 0.4 s stun. Arcane.

skills.name: Throwing Stars
skills.desc: No clip (the arm is thrown by hand): three steel stars, 6 each, bleeding.

skills.name: Ninja Flurry
skills.desc: Six cuts, then a kick that leaves a seven-pointed gold star, 12 r2.8, 1.1 s stun. Arcane, light.

skills.name: Twin Fangs
skills.desc: Two cuts then a crossing cut for 12 and a knock-back. Arcane, light.

skills.name: Fire Star
skills.desc: Thrown by hand: a fire star bursts r1.8 for 8 burn and leaves fire. Fire.

skills.name: Spin Kick
skills.desc: A full spinning kick, 9 bash r2.3, shove. Arcane.

skills.name: Star Storm
skills.desc: Thrown by hand: runs round the foe for 2.6 s throwing stars of every element.

skills.name: Frost Stars
skills.desc: Thrown by hand: three frost stars, 6 each, 1 s stun, slowed. Frost.

skills.name: Whirlwind
skills.desc: Pose held, spinning 2–3 turns, cutting every quarter turn. Arcane.

skills.name: Storm Star
skills.desc: Thrown by hand: a storm star that jumps to two or more other foes. Storm.

skills.name: Rising Dragon
skills.desc: A rising spin that lifts the foe, 12, then a landing slash, 0.5 s stun. Arcane.

skills.name: Spirit Star
skills.desc: Thrown by hand: two seeking spirit stars that pierce and come back. Spirit.

skills.name: Kick Chain
skills.desc: Flying kicks from foe to foe (2–4), 12 each. Arcane.

skills.name: Substitution
skills.desc: A log and smoke: blinks 4.5 m off, heals 12%, throws three stars.

skills.name: Great Shuriken
skills.desc: A giant four-bladed star thrown out and back, piercing, 16 and bleeding. Arcane.

skills.name: Spear Barrage
skills.desc: After the leaps: a ring of spears falls on the foe, r2.9, 20. Spirit.

skills.name: Jump
skills.desc: Leaps onto the foe and lands spear first, 14 r2, the spear planted in the ground. Spirit.

skills.name: Lance Flurry
skills.desc: Six thrusts, 5 each, the last 9 and a knock-back.

skills.name: Dragon Dive
skills.desc: A dive, 18 r2.4, fire on the ground 3 s. Fire.

skills.name: Spearstep
skills.desc: Dashes through at 19 m/s, 20, 0.4 s stun.

skills.name: Spiral Lance
skills.desc: A thrown spear of light, piercing, 16.

skills.name: Sweeping Lance
skills.desc: A flat sweep r3.2, 12, shove.

skills.name: Comet Dive
skills.desc: A high fast dive, 24 r3, scorched ground. Light, fire.

skills.name: Lance Barrier
skills.desc: Six spears orbit him for 6 s, 5 each.

skills.name: Storm Dive
skills.desc: A dive, 22 r2.8, then lightning to three or more foes. Storm.

skills.name: Spear Rain
skills.desc: No clip (points to the sky): 15 or more spears rain over r3.2 for 1.6 s.

skills.name: Dragon Breath
skills.desc: Pose held 1.3 s: a sweeping cone of fire 4.4 m. Fire.

skills.name: Dragonfall
skills.desc: A great dive, 44 r3.8, 1.2 s stun, wings of fire. Fire.

skills.name: Heaven's Rain
skills.desc: No clip (points to the sky): golden spears rain, then one giant spear for 30; faster and harder for 6 s. Light.

skills.name: Double Throw
skills.desc: Right hand, then the left a moment later: two wide-curving rangs, 9 each. Light.

skills.name: Cross Cut
skills.desc: Both rangs cross on the foe, 10 each and an 8 gold cross-cut. Light.

skills.name: Energy Boomerang
skills.desc: A huge piercing gold rang that comes back, 13. Light.

skills.name: Wind Slash
skills.desc: A growing crescent that pierces, 12. Light.

skills.name: Chakram
skills.desc: A bladed ring bouncing across four or more foes, 9 and bleeding. Light.

skills.name: Orbiting Boomerangs
skills.desc: Two or more rangs orbit him for 7 s, 4 each. Light.

skills.name: Homing Salvo
skills.desc: Thrown by hand: 15 small rangs fan out, hang, then all home on one foe. Light.

skills.name: Tempest Dash
skills.desc: A crouch, then a 32 m/s dash through foes, 14 and bleeding, 8 r2.2 at the end. Light.

skills.name: Blade Ring
skills.desc: One spin flinging 8 or more rangs every way, 7 each; they come back. Light.

skills.name: Bladestorm Dance
skills.desc: Six rangs orbit as he spins about 2.4 s, then eight fly out. Light.

skills.name: Golden Boomerang
skills.desc: A giant slow gold rang, 34 bash, 0.6 s stun; its threads cut on the way back. Light.

skills.name: Razor Tornado
skills.desc: No clip (points): a wandering tornado for about 4 s pulls foes in and cuts. Light.

skills.name: Throw
skills.desc: The ordinary throw: the right-hand rang curves out and back, 9. Light.

skills.name: Catch
skills.desc: No clip: a returning rang caught with a flash at the hand.

skills.name: War Song
skills.desc: One of the singing clips (upper body), the lute played by hand: the party does 25% more damage for 20 s. Fire.

skills.name: Marching Song
skills.desc: The singing clips and the lute: the party is 25% faster for 20 s; sung on the road too. Storm.

skills.name: Mending Song
skills.desc: The singing clips and the lute: a healing song for 6 s, when an ally is below 70%. Heal.

skills.name: Power Chord
skills.desc: No clip (the lute played by hand): Three fire notes, 9 and a shove. Fire.

skills.name: Fan of Notes
skills.desc: No clip (the lute played by hand): Six or more rainbow notes in a fan, 6 and bleeding.

skills.name: Shockwave Riff
skills.desc: No clip (the lute played by hand): Rings of shock march out to about 9 m, 8 bash, 0.3 s stun. Storm.

skills.name: Echo
skills.desc: No clip (the lute played by hand): A bouncing note and two fainter echoes. Spirit, frost.

skills.name: Dancing Notes
skills.desc: No clip (the lute played by hand): Notes bounce between foes, 5 each. Heal, light.

skills.name: Bass Drop
skills.desc: No clip (the lute played by hand): A giant note falls on the foe, 20 r2.5, 1.2 s stun. Arcane.

skills.name: Swashbuckle
skills.desc: Three dashes, 10 each and bleeding, then a back-flip away and a sting on the lute. Arcane.

skills.name: Resonance Beam
skills.desc: No clip (the lute played by hand): An 11 m beam of staves for 1.4 s. Spirit.

skills.name: Lullaby
skills.desc: No clip (the lute played by hand): Foes within 6 m fall asleep 2.2 s and are slowed. Frost.

skills.name: Sonic Boom
skills.desc: No clip (the lute played by hand): Two blasts r5.2, 10, shove, 0.5 s stun. Light.

skills.name: Crescendo
skills.desc: No clip (the lute played by hand): Four growing notes, 5/9/13/17, the last pierces and stuns. Light.

skills.name: The Grand Finale
skills.desc: The lute for 2.5 s: six rainbow fireworks, then 26 r4.2 and a stun; ends with a bow.
